description: This Java source file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named HealthController. It provides a health check endpoint at GET /health, returning a JSON payload indicating the application's status. The class is annotated with OpenAPI tags for documentation and exposes a single method 'health' that returns a map with status information.

classes.name: HealthController
classes.description: Rest controller exposing a health check endpoint at /health, providing a simple application status response.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Handles GET requests to /health, returning a JSON with status 'UP'.
